text:
akshay: FYI I'm starting the Argent customer LoRA merge bring-up on int4 today, focused on quick compatibility + perf checks. sending a small eval pack in a minute

sophie: awesome — is this the warm-blend variant (merge+base smoothing) or straight graft?

akshay: warm-blend. we saw weird token probs on delta merges before, so smoothing first. eval pack: 120 prompts (50 convo, 50 instruction, 20 numeric). short runtime smoke only.

tanner: can you include the baseline runs (fp16 + int8) so we can compare token cost/latency numbers?

akshay: yes — baseline fp16 + int8 quantized baseline. plan: run on rtx-a6000 pool, 2048 context, batch=8, collect lat/rtoken and perplexity-ish proxy (next-token logprobs on held set).

sophie: naming for artifacts? put in s3://redwood-evals/argent/arg-warmblend-1751112345/ so ops can fetch.

akshay: done. uploaded eval pack + run script. kicking off now.

ml-ci-bot: CI started for run 1751112345-eval on infra: rtx-a6000-pool. estimated duration 7m.

ml-ci-bot: quick status: model loaded, kv-cache warm, running batch 0/15.

akshay: first pass looks okay. sampling temperature=0.0 for deterministic scoring. logs: `WARN: token-aliasing detected on numeric sequences (0.2% cases)` — capturing examples.

eva: can you paste 2-3 examples of token-aliasing? want to check if tokenizer remap needed before shipping to Argent.

akshay: pasted samples to the s3 run folder under examples/token_aliasing.txt. short example: "Invoice 1,200 -> 1200" token split changed leading comma into separate token, affects numeric canonicalization.

tanner: results summary (prelim): fp16 baseline: avg rtoken 12.4ms, avgLL -1.92; int8: 9.1ms, avgLL -2.10; warm-blend-int4: 6.3ms, avgLL -2.35. top-line: ~35% latency win vs int8, quality hit measurable but within Argent tolerance on NLU probes (intent acc drop 0.8%).

sophie: that's promising. any behavioral regressions on instruction suite?

akshay: ran instruction pass — 120 prompts, pass rate 91% vs fp16 93%. failing ones are mostly lengthier multi-step instructions; flagged for follow-up.

eva: request: collect top 20 diffs and link them in the ticket (ENG-ML-889). also include a few golden examples where int4 hallucinated extra steps.

akshay: added diffs to ticket and the s3 folder.

ml-ci-bot: CI finished: exit_code 0, artifacts uploaded: metrics.json, examples/, logs.txt.

sophie: next steps: 1) run a small canary in dedicated pool for 24h with customer traffic shim; 2) try tightening quantization/embedding scale for the 3 failing prompts; 3) decide on rollback safety net (fallback to int8 variant).

tanner: I can pick up the canary infra tomorrow. if we keep fallback route ready we can ship early for Argent pilot.

eva: agree. small ask for docs team: add explicit note about numeric tokenization caveat for warm-blend-int4 in release notes.

akshay: noted. thanks everyone, will update ENG-ML-889 with canary schedule and a short summary. :thumbsup:
